_meta.purpose: Busy-parent population caps: limited time availability, 2–3 sessions per week maximum.

name: Busy Parent
description: Optimised for 2–3 sessions per week, 30–45 minutes each. Full-body compound focus with minimal setup time.
notes: Prioritise compound movements that hit multiple muscle groups per minute of training. StrongLifts 5x5 or a 3-day abbreviated GZCLP fit naturally within these constraints.

sources: Ralston et al. 2017 effect of load and volume on strength gains
